glosses.notes: Describes people who feel close, affectionate, or like family.

examples.sentence: 这两个孩子从小就很亲。
我们两家常见面，所以很亲。

example_translations.translation: These two children have been very close since childhood.
She has always been closest to her grandmother.
Our two families are very close because we see each other often.

glosses.notes: Describes a warm, gentle, and friendly manner.

example_translations.translation: The new teacher speaks in a very warm and friendly way.
She has always been very friendly to us.
She spoke to me very warmly.

glosses.notes: Refers to one's close family or loved ones.

examples.sentence: 在外地工作时，我常想亲人。

example_translations.translation: During the New Year, all the family members came home.
The people she wants to see most are still her loved ones.
When I work away from home, I often miss my family.

glosses.notes: Means doing something yourself rather than having someone else do it.

examples.sentence: 校长亲自来教室看我们。

example_translations.translation: The principal personally came to the classroom to see us.
This letter was written by him personally.
My mom personally went to the airport to pick me up.

glosses.notes: Refers to feelings and emotional expression.

examples.sentence: 她不太会表达自己的情感。

example_translations.translation: The emotions in this movie feel very real.
She is not very good at expressing her own feelings.
There is a lot of emotion in his paintings.

glosses.notes: Used for a situation, condition, or what is going on.

examples.sentence: 医生说他的情况好多了。
现在情况比昨天好一点。

example_translations.translation: Let's look at the situation first, then decide.
The doctor said his condition is much better.
The situation is a little better today than yesterday.

glosses.notes: Means to respectfully ask someone for advice or guidance.

examples.sentence: 这个问题我想请教老师。
有不懂的地方可以请教我。
她常去请教有经验的人。

example_translations.translation: I want to ask the teacher about this question.
If there is something you do not understand, you can ask me.
She often goes to ask experienced people for advice.

glosses.notes: To celebrate a person, event, or success.

examples.sentence: 今天我们一起庆祝生日。
球队赢了以后大家一起庆祝。
他们用唱歌来庆祝成功。

example_translations.translation: Today we are celebrating a birthday together.
After the team won, everyone celebrated together.
They used singing to celebrate their success.

glosses.notes: A fan of a sport or team, especially ball games.

examples.sentence: 这个球迷看了整场比赛。

example_translations.translation: He has been a sports fan for many years.
The fans were all wearing red clothes.
This fan watched the whole match.

glosses.notes: Used for an area, district, or region of a city or place.

examples.sentence: 我住在东区，不住在西区。

example_translations.translation: I live in the east district, not the west district.
This district has a large population.
This area is very close to the center.

glosses.notes: Can mean a difference, or the act of telling things apart.

examples.sentence: 我还不会区别这两种花。

example_translations.translation: These two words have a small difference.
I still cannot tell these two kinds of flowers apart.
There is a big difference between the new and old methods.

glosses.notes: Means to cancel, remove, or call something off.

examples.sentence: 我们决定取消原来的计划。

example_translations.translation: Because of the rain, the event was canceled.
We decided to cancel the original plan.
The teacher said the exam will not be called off.

glosses.notes: A respectful way to say that someone died.

examples.sentence: 这位老人去世以后，大家都来了。
奶奶去世以后，她常想她。

example_translations.translation: His grandfather passed away last year.
After this elderly man passed away, everyone came.
After her grandmother passed away, she often thought about her.

glosses.primary_gloss: the whole audience; the whole venue
glosses.notes: Refers to everyone present in a venue or the entire hall or stadium.

examples.sentence: 他一出来，全场都安静了。
这句话让全场笑了起来。
他说完以后，全场都笑了。

example_translations.translation: As soon as he came out, the whole audience went quiet.
That sentence made the whole audience laugh.
After he finished speaking, the whole venue laughed.

glosses.notes: Describes something complete and covering all sides.

example_translations.translation: This plan is still not comprehensive enough.
He has been thinking things through very thoroughly.
She explained the issue in a very complete way.

glosses.notes: Refers to the whole world or something worldwide.

examples.sentence: 全球都在关注这个问题。
这家公司在全球都有店。
天气变化影响全球生活。

example_translations.translation: The whole world is paying attention to this issue.
This company has stores all over the world.
Weather changes affect life around the globe.

glosses.notes: Means that something is missing or not enough.

example_translations.translation: We are still one person short today.
A name is missing on this form.
One sentence is missing from the letter he wrote.

glosses.notes: A flaw or weak point in a person or thing.

examples.sentence: 每个人都有自己的缺点。
她知道自己的缺点，所以一直在改。

example_translations.translation: Everyone has their own shortcomings.
His biggest weakness is that he is too impatient.
She knows her own shortcomings, so she has been working on them.

glosses.notes: Means not having enough of something that is needed.

examples.sentence: 我们这里缺少年轻老师。
这篇文章缺少一个例子。

example_translations.translation: It is not good for children to lack exercise.
We are short of young teachers here.
This article lacks an example.

glosses.notes: Means making certain that something happens or is true.

examples.sentence: 我们要确保大家都安全。
老师先确保每个人都听懂。

example_translations.translation: Please make sure the door has already been closed.
We need to make sure everyone is safe.
The teacher first made sure everyone understood.

glosses.notes: Can mean to confirm something or to be certain and settled.

examples.sentence: 你确定自己没有问题吗？

example_translations.translation: The departure time has not been confirmed yet.
Are you sure you do not have any problems?
The teacher finalized the list today.

glosses.notes: Used to emphasize that something is really true.

example_translations.translation: This really is not easy.
What he said really makes sense.
You really did come late today.

glosses.notes: A skirt or dress-like lower garment.

example_translations.translation: This skirt suits you very well.
She is wearing a blue skirt.
I want to buy a long skirt.

glosses.notes: Used for a group of people or animals.

example_translations.translation: A group of students is waiting outside.
A crowd of fans is standing at the door.
A flock of birds flew across the sky.

glosses.notes: Means loving something deeply and with strong feeling.

examples.sentence: 很多人热爱自己的工作。
她热爱和孩子一起学习。

example_translations.translation: He has loved music deeply since childhood.
Many people are devoted to their work.
She loves learning together with children.

glosses.notes: Describes a warm, lively, and enthusiastic atmosphere or response.

example_translations.translation: Everyone gave the new teacher an enthusiastic welcome.
Everyone clapped enthusiastically to welcome him.
Everyone's welcome was extremely warm.

glosses.notes: Refers to a capable or talented person, especially one who is valuable.

example_translations.translation: This company really needs talented people.
The teacher said he is a real talent.
This kind of talent is hard to find.

glosses.notes: Can mean man-made or done by human labor rather than automatically.

example_translations.translation: This lake is not a man-made lake.
These flowers were made by hand.
This still has to be done by hand.

glosses.notes: Refers to human beings as a whole.

example_translations.translation: Humanity needs to protect the earth together.
Humankind has always been making progress.
Human beings can get sick too.

glosses.notes: Refers to the people as a whole, often in public or social contexts.

example_translations.translation: The people's lives are getting better and better.
The people hope for a better life.
Everyone believes in the strength of the people.

glosses.notes: China's currency, the renminbi.

examples.sentence: 这本书要三十元人民币。
外国朋友先换了人民币。

example_translations.translation: This book costs thirty yuan.
I brought some renminbi with me.
Our foreign friend exchanged for renminbi first.

glosses.notes: A crowd or mass of people gathered together.

example_translations.translation: He walked right into the crowd.
The crowd slowly moved toward the door.
I recognized her in the crowd.

glosses.notes: Refers to a person's life as a whole.

example_translations.translation: Life will not always go smoothly.
This book tells the story of his life.
The teacher often talks with us about life.

glosses.notes: Refers to staff, personnel, or people involved in a group or activity.

example_translations.translation: There are not many staff members for this event.
All the staff members on the list have arrived.
The people at the scene left at once.

glosses.notes: To recognize someone or something after seeing or hearing them.

examples.sentence: 她一开口，我就认出了她。

example_translations.translation: I recognized him at a glance.
As soon as she started speaking, I recognized her.
Who can you identify in the photo?

glosses.notes: Means to know or recognize a person, place, or thing.

examples.sentence: 这么多年了，他还认得我。

example_translations.translation: Do you still recognize this teacher?
I know the road up ahead.
After so many years, he still recognizes me.

glosses.notes: Means to approve of, accept, or recognize something as valid or good.

examples.sentence: 这份工作得到了家里人的认可。

example_translations.translation: Everyone approves of this method.
The teacher really recognizes her progress.
This job won the approval of her family.

glosses.notes: Used for appointing someone to a role or position.

example_translations.translation: The school appointed her class monitor.
The company appointed him group leader.
The school assigned him to lead this class.

glosses.notes: Used in patterns meaning no matter who, what, or how.

examples.sentence: 任天气多冷，他也去跑步。

example_translations.translation: No matter how you choose, it is all fine.
No matter what he says, I do not believe it.
No matter how cold the weather is, he still goes running.

glosses.notes: Used to mean any person or thing without exception.

examples.sentence: 这里不能带任何吃的东西。

example_translations.translation: I do not have any questions right now.
Anyone can give an opinion.
You cannot bring any food here.

glosses.notes: A task, job, or assignment that needs to be completed.

examples.sentence: 今天的任务已经完成了。
老师给我们分了新任务。

example_translations.translation: Today's task has already been completed.
The teacher assigned us a new task.
This task is harder than the last one.

glosses.notes: Used to say that something continues without change.

examples.sentence: 大家都走了，她仍不想回家。
过了这么久，他仍记得那天。

example_translations.translation: The rain stopped, but he still stood outside.
Everyone had left, but she still did not want to go home.
After all this time, he still remembers that day.

glosses.notes: Used to emphasize that something is still the case.

examples.sentence: 过了半年，他仍然住在这里。

example_translations.translation: It is dark now, but it is still very hot outside.
Half a year later, he still lives here.
Everyone left, but she was still sitting there.

glosses.notes: Refers to everyday life or routine matters.

examples.sentence: 运动是日常生活的一部分。
老师常从日常小事开始讲。

example_translations.translation: Exercise is a part of daily life.
These are all everyday issues.
The teacher often starts from small routine matters.

glosses.notes: Can mean easy to do, or likely to happen under certain conditions.

example_translations.translation: This problem is not very easy.
It is easy to get tired when driving at night.
In this kind of weather, people easily catch colds.

glosses.notes: Used to ask or discuss how something should be done.

examples.sentence: 老师问我们如何准备考试。
现在最重要的是如何解决问题。

example_translations.translation: What do you think of this method?
The teacher asked us how to prepare for the exam.
What matters most now is how to solve the problem.

glosses.notes: To walk around for relaxation or exercise.

examples.sentence: 晚饭后我们去河边散步。
天气凉了，很多人出来散步。

example_translations.translation: After dinner, we go for a walk by the river.
He goes for a walk every morning.
Now that the weather is cooler, many people come out for a walk.

glosses.notes: A sofa or couch used for sitting.

examples.sentence: 爷爷正坐在沙发上看报。

example_translations.translation: Grandpa is sitting on the sofa reading the newspaper.
The sofa at my home is very new.
The cat jumped onto the sofa and fell asleep.

glosses.notes: Sand or fine grains found on beaches, the ground, or in shoes.

examples.sentence: 风一大，沙子就飞起来了。

example_translations.translation: A lot of sand got into my shoes.
My hands are covered with sand.
Once the wind gets strong, the sand starts flying up.

glosses.notes: Can mean to injure the body or to hurt someone's feelings.

examples.sentence: 别让这点小事伤了感情。

example_translations.translation: He injured his leg while running.
What he said was too hurtful.
Do not let this small matter hurt the relationship.

glosses.notes: Describes feeling sad or emotionally hurt.

examples.sentence: 听到这个消息，她很伤心。
他看见旧照片又伤心了。

example_translations.translation: She was very sad when she heard the news.
Do not be too heartbroken over this small matter.
He saw the old photo and became sad again.

glosses.notes: Items that are made or sold in a store or market.

examples.sentence: 顾客先看商品，再决定买不买。

example_translations.translation: This shop has a very full range of goods.
There are more and more products online.
Customers look at the goods first, then decide whether to buy them.

glosses.notes: Used for business activity or things related to commerce.

example_translations.translation: This street is a business center.
He wants to learn a little business knowledge.
Commercial development here is very fast.

glosses.notes: A directional verb meaning to come upward or toward the speaker.

examples.sentence: 菜一上来，大家就开始吃。

example_translations.translation: Come up and sit for a while first.
He ran up from downstairs to find me.
As soon as the dishes came up, everyone started eating.

glosses.notes: Refers to the upper side or the place above something.

example_translations.translation: Your book is on top of the table.
There is a small house higher up on the mountain.
Your name is written on the paper.

glosses.notes: Can mean moving upward or away, and in some patterns it means something seems a certain way.

example_translations.translation: We can walk up and take a look.
The cat jumped up right away.
This dish looks pretty good.

glosses.notes: Used for numbers, temperatures, prices, or levels going up.

example_translations.translation: The number of people has been rising recently.
The temperature started to rise in the afternoon.
The number of people signing up is still increasing.

glosses.notes: Clothing worn on the upper part of the body.

example_translations.translation: This top is a little too big.
It is cool now, so put your jacket on.
I want to buy a white top.

glosses.notes: Tools, machines, or facilities used for a purpose.

examples.sentence: 教室里新加了很多设备。
没有这些设备，工作很难做。

example_translations.translation: This hospital has very good equipment.
A lot of new equipment was added to the classroom.
Without this equipment, the work is hard to do.

glosses.notes: Can mean a design itself or the act of designing something.

examples.sentence: 这把椅子的设计很特别。
这个公园设计得很方便。

example_translations.translation: The design of this chair is very special.
She is responsible for designing the new room.
This park was designed very conveniently.

glosses.notes: Means to establish, set up, or found something formally.

example_translations.translation: The school set up a new class.
The company established a new team.
A service desk has been set up here.

glosses.notes: Refers to society, social life, or the wider public world.

example_translations.translation: Everyone lives within society.
Society needs people like this.
Children slowly come to understand society.

glosses.notes: An official identification card.

example_translations.translation: I have my ID card.
I put my ID card in the bag.
She has been looking for her ID card.

glosses.notes: Describes physical depth or something intense and deep in feeling.

examples.sentence: 他对这个地方感情很深。

example_translations.translation: This river is deeper than it looks.
This cup is not deep; it is small.
He has deep feelings for this place.

glosses.notes: Describes something very deep, meaningful, or strongly remembered.

examples.sentence: 老师的话让我印象很深刻。
那次经历给她留下深刻印象。

example_translations.translation: The teacher's words left a deep impression on me.
That experience left a profound impression on her.
His answer was very profound.
